I have $971 and am on PENNSYLVANIA_AVENUE after paying $28 rent. I need to buy Virginia, Tennessee, and New York to complete my pink and orange monopolies. p4 now holds two of the three light blue properties, so I must secure the third.

Building three houses on each light blue property costs $450. That would give me a strong rent income if I owned the full set. I am now considering whether p4 would sell both Oriental and Connecticut for cash.

I suspect p4 would reject a cash offer for their light blues, since they previously refused cash for Ventnor and Park Place. I am now considering trading with p3 instead.

I ruled out trading with p3 and p2. p3 has no color sets I need, and p2's holdings are irrelevant to my monopolies. The best path is to end my turn and keep the $971 to buy Virginia, Tennessee, or New York.
